Account Privacy

Delete your account

This can't be undone.

Accounts are coming soon. Krunk works fully without one; an account will only be needed for sync.

What is deleted

  • Everything at once: your account, its devices and sign-ins, its activity and IP addresses, and all your encrypted sync data and keys on the server.
  • Your Krunk browsers are signed out and stop syncing. What they hold locally stays on them.
  • Our backups still hold it until they expire, within 14 days. If we ever restore one, deleted accounts are deleted again.
